title: End-of-life target framework (net6.0)
description: The project targets net6.0, out of support since November 2024. Retargeting is a framework migration, not a package bump: the library fixer finds no PackageReference to change and must hand it to a human without editing anything.
notes: An explicit "framework migration → human" route would be better than relying on the fixer failing; listed as an open item.
